# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability privately

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/wadyatalkinabewt/koe/security/advisories/new)
for suspected security or privacy issues. Do not open a public issue for an
unresolved vulnerability.

Include the affected commit, Windows and Python versions, reproduction steps,
and the likely impact. Never attach real API keys, recordings, transcripts,
configuration files, or unredacted logs. Replace private content with a minimal
synthetic example.

## Supported code

Security fixes target the current `main` branch. Koe does not currently publish
versioned binaries or support older public release lines.

Provider-side issues in ElevenLabs or OpenRouter should also be reported to the
relevant provider when their service is the affected boundary.
